title: A Pogorelov estimate along flat directions for optimal transport on convex domains
author: Tristan C. Collins and Freid Tong
work: Boundary regularity of optimal transport maps on convex domains
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: original Proposition 7.1 of the article (source label prop: VeryGenPog, source0.tex lines 1260--1294), the general Pogorelov-type estimate along flat directions, delivered with the author's own complete 138-line proof at source0.tex lines 1295--1432. H2: even with the section definitions of the delivered context, the solver must reproduce a genuine boundary Pogorelov argument rather than an exercise. It must differentiate the Monge--Amp\`ere equation along the flat direction to obtain the linearised equation for $u_{11}$, form the quantity $\Phi=\log u_{11}+\log|u|+\frac12u_1^2$, and then split the maximum of $\Phi$ over the section into the interior case, where the concavity of the log-determinant and the structural conditions force the second-order test to fail, and the boundary case, where the boundary equation, the tangential derivatives, the log-concavity of the target density with its Euler identity, and finally a shearing transformation preserving the flat direction are needed to reduce the boundary point to the interior case. The estimate is uniform in the data and is the technical input for the mixed-homogeneity shape theorems of the same section, so it is well beyond ordinary PhD qualifying level.
